insights.headline: CLE lined up under center less often than in any game since 2013
insights.body: 7.7% of their snaps came from under center. That is the lowest in all 216 games on record since 2013.

insights.headline: PHI drew flags on their opponent more often than in any game since Week 1 of 2018
insights.body: PHI's opponents were flagged 13 times. No game since Week 1 of 2018 has matched it — a run of 136 games.

insights.headline: Drake Maye's day ranks 57th out of 7,130 QB games since 2013
insights.body: Drake Maye put up +0.84 EPA per dropback on 35 dropbacks vs LV — the 57th-best quarterback game since 2013, out of 7,130 with at least 20 dropbacks. That is the top 1% of every game in the era.

insights.headline: MIA have lost 5 straight, their longest run since Week 17 of 2022
insights.body: 5 losses in a row through week 5, the latest 24–31 to CIN. They had not put together a run this long in 57 games, going back to Week 17 of 2022.
